reason: First speed review for rustfmtstr after main f874 integration; balanced protocol declared before all samples.
method: 192 balanced randomized three-arm rounds; all six permutations per six-round block, independently shuffled. Moving interference is handled by resampling complete six-round blocks; CPU affinity is fixed within the run.
acceptance: Every original ratio-of-medians CPU/wall comparison AND every upper confidence bound on the ratio of mean CPU/wall times must be <= 5%. All complete results retained; no automatic retry on failure.
cpu_selection: Rank allowed physical CPU pairs by minimum sibling idle percentage over five seconds; assign the highest-ranked distinct pairs to cases before collecting any timings. No absolute idle threshold. No owned builds/tests/corpus work during measurements; only these measurement workers run concurrently.
execution: Shared scheduler; independent cases across three features on disjoint physical CPU pairs
execution_amendment: Only benchmark cases share the scheduler. Physical CPU pairs remain disjoint across all cases, with fixed affinity per run and worker-local child CPU accounting. Production sources and binaries are frozen; pending baseline commit identities are bound afterward using existing manifests.
